title.narrative: Systemic Support to Health Services in Haiti - Haiti (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Haiti, RSSH, Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Population (Unité de Gestion des Projets) (Unite de Gestion des projets)This program has the following goals: D’ici à l’horizon 2030, le VIH n’est plus une menace de santé publique grâce à la mise en œuvre de stratégies accélérées au bénéfice de toutes les populations y inclus populations vulnérables et populations clés à travers une approche de soins centrée sur la personne et l’implication des communautés / By 2030, HIV is no longer a public health threat thanks to the implementation of accelerated strategies for the benefit of all populations, including vulnerable populations and key populations, through a person-centered care approach and community involvement.. Réduire la transmission, la morbidité et la mortalité de la tuberculose au niveau des dix (10) départements géographiques du pays pour arriver à la fin de l'épidémie par l'obtention de zéro décès et de maladie et de souffrances dus à la tuberculose. / Reduce the transmission, morbidity, and mortality of tuberculosis in the ten (10) geographical departments of the country to achieve the end of the epidemic by obtaining zero deaths and no disease or suffering due to tuberculosis.. Contribuer à l’amélioration de la santé des populations d’Haïti par l’interruption de la transmission autochtone de la malaria. / Contribute to the improvement of the health of the population in Haiti by interrupting the indigenous transmission of malaria.. Répondre aux besoins des trois programmes (TB, VIH et paludisme) grâce à des activités transversales visant à renforcer le système de santé confronté à des défis chroniques et systémiques. / Meet the needs of the three programs (TB, HIV and Malaria) with cross-cutting activities to strengthen the health system beset by chronic and systemic challenges.. The objectives of this program are: Les nouvelles infections sont réduites de 90% dans la population générale et dans les groupes cibles prioritaires d’ici à 2026 / New infections are reduced by 90% in the general population and in the priority target groups by 2026.. D’ici à fin 2023, le taux de survie à 12 mois des enfants et adultes traités par ARV atteint 90% / By the end of 2023, the 12-month survival rate of children and adults treated with antiretroviral therapy (ARV) reaches 90%.. Réduction de la mortalité par tuberculose de 75% d'ici 2025 (de sa valeur de 2015) / A 75% reduction in tuberculosis mortality by 2025 (from its 2015 level).. Réduction du taux d'incidence de 50% d'ici 2025 (de sa valeur de 2015) / A 50% reduction in the incidence rate by 2025 (from its 2015 level).. 100% des cas suspects dans la population ont accès à un diagnostic précoce soutenu par un programme d’assurance qualité et ont accès à un traitement efficace sans délai. / 100% of suspected cases in the population have access to early diagnosis supported by a quality assurance program and have immediate access to effective treatment.. Renforcer la surveillance de la malaria, le suivi et l’évaluation du programme à tous les niveaux, y compris au niveau institutionnel et au niveau communautaire / Enhance malaria surveillance, program monitoring, and evaluation at all levels, including institutional and community levels.. Renforcer la surveillance entomologique de la malaria à tous les niveaux et s’assurer que 100% des foyers ont accès aux mesures efficaces de protection contre la malaria/ Strengthen entomological surveillance of malaria at all levels and ensure that 100% of households have access to effective malaria protection measures.. Contribuer par des interventions de communication efficaces à l’élimination de la transmission locale de la malaria en Haïti d’ici décembre 2025 / Contribute through effective communication interventions to the elimination of local malaria transmission in Haiti by December 2025.

LMIS Reporting Rate - Percentage of all health facilities that are required to report that submit an LMIS report to central authority
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
Percentage of reporting units which digitally enter and submit data at the reporting unit level using the electronic information system
Percentage of molecular diagnostic analyzers achieving at least 85% functionality (ability to test samples) during the reporting period
Timeliness of reporting: Percentage of submitted monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Completeness of reporting: Percentage of expected monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
